title: Higher direct image stalk over a field via algebraic closure
statement: Let $K$ be a field, $L$ an algebraic closure of $K$, and $a:X\to\operatorname{Spec}K$ a finite-type morphism. Let $F$ be a torsion abelian etale sheaf on $X$ and $q\geq0$. With geometric stalks [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks], direct image [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], and cohomology [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology], there is an additive equivalence $(R^qa_*F)_{\operatorname{Spec}L}\simeq H^q(X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}K}\operatorname{Spec}L,F|)$. Torsion has the local-section meaning [def-weil-pbc-torsion-etale-sheaf].

proof.text: Finite type over a field gives the needed locally Noetherian and quasi-separated instances for the morphism a, so the strict-henselization stalk formula applies.

For s:Spec L -> Spec K, apply the proved upstream theorem AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.isUniversalHomeomorphism_spec_strictHenselizationEval from StrictHenselizationField. Its field-specific argument makes evaluation injective using reduced Artinian etale K-algebras, identifies the strict henselization as a field, and proves L purely inseparable over it. Work directly over strictLocalizationToBase s with h = Spec.map (strictHenselizationEval s). The upstream theorem spec_map_strictHenselizationEval_comp_strictLocalizationToBase proves h followed by this structural map equals s. The small-colimit comparison is not needed for this field argument.

Apply the official strictHenselizationStalkFormula to a, s, F and q in its strictLocalization presentation. The existing private helper nonempty_addEquiv_strictLocalization_toBase composes its stalk-to-global-sections isomorphism with the right-derived/homology comparison, the global-sections/cohomology comparison, and the derived-sections identification.

Pull back the universal-homeomorphism h along a to obtain g by pullback.lift. The pullback square proves g is a universal homeomorphism. Topological invariance gives cohomologyEquiv g, and upperStarComp identifies the iterated pullback with the base change to Spec L; composing these additive equivalences proves the displayed result.

Retain the current small-model private compatibility helpers for the import-all consumers. strictHenselizationComparison_over follows from smallStrictHenselizationColimitIso_toBase by inverse cancellation. For nonempty_addEquiv_strictLocalization, form the induced pullback isomorphism and its explicit inverse; transport the upstream stalk formula by cohomologyEquiv and upperStarComp. These helpers and their signatures are unchanged from the current source.

theorem nonempty_addEquiv_sheafFiber_rightDerived_lowerStar_of_isAlgClosure
    {K : Type u} [Field K] (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    [IsAlgClosure K L] [IsAlgClosed L] {X : Scheme.{u}} (a : X ⟶ Spec (.of K))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType a] [QuasiCompact a]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (hF : F.IsTorsion)
    (q : ℕ) :
    Nonempty
      ((((Scheme.pointSmallEtale (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))).sheafFiber
          (A := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj
          (((lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} a).rightDerived q).obj F)) ≃+
        Sheaf.H ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
          (pullback.fst a (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))))).obj F) q)
lean.note: The explicit IsAlgClosed L instance is redundant with IsAlgClosure K L; it makes elaboration of the geometric point independent of reverse instance search for K.
